image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a circular aneroid barometer with a brass or gold-toned metallic casing. The face is silver/white with concentric rings of markings and text. Two ornate black pointer hands are visible in the center. The background appears to be dark wood paneling. There is significant glare/reflection on the upper left quadrant of the glass cover.
